name_zh: 大樓上蓋結構施工(模板/紮鐵/落石矢)

work_steps.step: Lorries delivery materials (timber, false work components, misc. materials) to site

hazards.hazard: Collision with public road vehicles & pedestrians
control_measures: Assign traffic controller to coordinate site traffic & passer-by
To ensure no parking along site entrance
Delivery vehicle drivers should familiarize with routing
Avoid transportation during peak hours (07:50-08:15, 15:45-16:45)
Permit system enforced to control traffic flow

work_steps.step: Lifting formwork material using tower crane

control_measures: No over-capacity lifting
Do not temper any safety device
Ensure clear lifting route
No lifting during heavy rain, typhoon signal No. 3 or above
Check load chart to ensure sufficient lifting capacity
Check crane in safe working order before work commencement
Stop lifting when abnormalities are observed.
Do not use crane for pulling purpose.
All Lifting Gear must process valid certificate
Use color code system
Daily checking of all LG before use
Proper rigging method to be used
Discard all damaged LG, especially webbing sling & steel wires
Ensure ELS are fully disengaged before lifting.
Tower crane & its operator must process valid certificate.
Operator perform daily check and to fill in LA/LG Form 1 and & in-house checklist
No over-capacity lifting
Do not temper any safety device on tower crane
Ensure clearance of lifting path
Do not use tower crane for pulling purpose
Lifting zone to be left fenced-off and with warning size displayed.
Do not use tower crane for pulling purpose
Ensure ELS are fully disengaged before lifting.

hazards.hazard: Injury caused by unauthorized entry of fence-off area
control_measures: Operation area to be fenced-off with warning signs displayed
Work must be stopped upon unauthorized entry is found
Site personnel to confirm no other works to be performed within fence-off area。
Site foreman to be on watch to prohibit unauthorized entry
Use double-end guide rope
Do not use crane for pulling purpose
Workers must not stand directly in front of the path of suspended load
No lifting during heavy rain, typhoon signal No. 3 or above
All personnel (crane operator, banksman, rigger) must process valid certificates
No sudden movement of crane during lifting
Mark out all “dead zone” in operation area and inform all workers during pre-work safety briefing.
Blow whistle to inform all workers before lifting
Place solid wooden blocks at unloading area to avoid toes and fingers being struck by suspended load

hazards.hazard: Injury caused by unauthorized entry of fence-off area
control_measures: Operation area to be fenced-off with warning signs displayed
Work must be stopped upon unauthorized entry is found
Site personnel to confirm no other works to be performed within fence-off area。
Site foreman to be on watch to prohibit unauthorized entry

work_steps.step: Lifting formwork material using tower crane (continue)

control_measures: All LG must proves valid certificate
All personnel (crane operator, banksman, rigger) must process valid certificates for their assigned tasks
Use guide ropes
Daily checking of all LG before use
Do not use LG for pulling purpose
No lifting during heavy rain, typhoon signal No. 3
Ensure clearance of lifting path.
Pre-work checking of walkie-talkie for effective communication
All suspended loads are hoist up at about 1m from ground to check for entanglement and secure rigging
Use double wrapper rigging
Lifting supervisors to supervise all lifting operations.
Blow whistle to inform all workers
Use material skip to hoist small objects (<1m)
Provide sufficient lighting during operation
Disassembly work to be stopped before 8am & after 6pm during short daylight season

work_steps.step: False work assembly

control_measures: All workers must wear full body harness with double lanyard and attached to independent life line anchored to secure point
False work ladder installed  in each level of false work for access and egress
Independent life line to be pre- installed at false walk assembly area for attachment of safety harness
Sufficient metal planks made ready to paving on top of each layer of false work
All cross members of false work must be secured before next layer can be erected.
False work erection must be performed by skilled workers with sufficient experience.
All false work design must be checked by RSE
False work must be erected according to approved method statement and design calculation.
All propping & pads must be installed properly
All cross members must be secured install and cannot be removed at will
No loading on false work is allowed until certified by structural engineers.
Workers not to stay in false work assembly area.

hazards.hazard: Workers fall from edges of  false work
control_measures: Fencing poles with attach points to be installed before form work is installed.
Floor edge fencing must follow Labour Department regulations.
No workers can remove any floor edge fencing without prior approval from foreman.
Provide access with twin hand rails and to be fixed at working floor
For manholes used for material transfer, provide portable covers to cover manholes when not used.
Fence out all manholes with warning signs displayed.

work_steps.step: Use of sawing bench

control_measures: Provide pushing stick
Sawing bench must have proper guarding and riving knife.
Emergency stop installed.
Unauthorized use of sawing bench is prohibited.
Unplug sawing bench when not in use.
Do not wear cotton gloves
Provide container bags to collect wood chips
Daily cleaning of wood chips
Provide powder type fire extinguisher at sawing bench
No smoking on site.
Sawing bench to be checked by certified electricians
Electric wires to be hung up or properly protected.

work_steps.step: Use of hand held tools (Hammer)

control_measures: Workers cannot maintain mental focus are not allowed to perform this task.
Only skilled workers with sufficient experience are allowed to work with hammers

work_steps.step: Handling of formwork materials

hazards.hazard: Twist injury induced by incorrect manual handling  (individual material less than 10 kg)
control_measures: Establish fixed routing
Give break for workers at fixed period
Use tower crane t to minimize the amount of manual handling
Conduct pre-work exercise
Identify which type of timber & false work can be carried by manual handling.

work_steps.step: Fixing railing by arc welding

control_measures: Enforce Hot work permit
Operation area to be fenced-off with warning signs displayed
Remove any object that can catch fire within work area
Powder fire extinguisher made ready within reach at operation area
Spray water at nearby area to prevent ignition by sparks
Conduct post work inspection to ensure no fire has been left
Workers wear long sleeve clothing, leather gloves and flame cutting mask for body protection
Use flame-resistant plating to shield off flying sparks (especially at areas close to Logos Academy)

hazards.hazard: eye discomfort and burns from the intense light and heat
control_measures: Use protective eyewear (flame cutting mask with polarized glasses)
Set up rest time for workers (5 mins / hour)
Stop work immediately when workers feel uncomfortable for their eyes
Shield off area with non-reflective barrier
Provide blower fan to ventilate toxic fumes
Provide workers with N95 mask

work_steps.step: Form work assembly within lift shaft area

control_measures: Lift shaft Permit system prescribed in CIC guideline be in place for entry control
Use of lift shaft working platform
Rigid barrier to be in place during re-location of lift shaft working platform
Design of working platform must be endorsed by RSE.
Railing must be fastened and checked by structural  engineer for tightness
List SWL of working platform and permitted no. of entries allowed.
Independent life line to be pre-installed within lift shaft.

hazards.hazard: Collapse of lift shaft working platform
control_measures: List SWL of working platform and permitted no. of entries allowed.
Independent life line to be pre-installed within lift shaft.
Do not store material on top of lift shaft working platform.
Fence-off lift shaft area unless work is needed.

work_steps.step: Above ground work (less then 2m)

control_measures: Use light working platform and other means prescribed in CIC guideline in above ground work
No A-ladder & wooden ladder is allowed on site.

work_steps.step: Bar bending (both on site & off site)

hazards.hazard: Twist injury induced by incorrect manual handling
control_measures: For large diameter rebar (Y32-Y50) that requires  multi-person manual handling, one person should be responsible for synchronizing movement of workers
Conduct pre-work exercise
Promotion of Safe working cycle

hazards.hazard: Slash injury induced by protruding rebars
control_measures: Establish fixed routing
Steel wires used to tie up rebars to be clean up daily
Stagnant water and debris to be cleaned
Wear safety shoes w/ sufficient treads

hazards.hazard: Hands & fingers struck by moving parts of bar bending machine/ moving rebars
control_measures: Operators who are mentally unfocused or sick are not allowed to work
Flashlight to be installed to warn operators
Workers to pay attention hand/finger position
Reinforced inspection for off-site bending yard
Site personnel to confirm no other work to be performed within fence-off area。
Electric cables to be hung up or protected underground by robust material
Workers should not wear damaged safety shoes

work_steps.step: Rebar to be transported by trucks

hazards.hazard: Collision with public road vehicles & pedestrians
control_measures: Crane operator & escort vehicles should familiarize with routing
Avoid transportation during peak hours (07:50-08:15, 15:45-16:45)

work_steps.step: Lifting operation involving rebars

control_measures: All suspended loads are hoist up at about 1m from ground to check for entanglement and secure rigging
Use double wrapper rigging
Lifting supervisors to supervise all lifting operations.
Blow whistle to inform nearby workers
Use Nylon straps to further secure rebar before rigging
Fence-off the loading / unloading zone

hazards.hazard: Mobile Crane collapse due to unstable footing
control_measures: Provide layout of crane deployment
Support structure of mobile crane to be checked by TCP/T 5
Check crane in safe working order before work commencement
Stop lifting when abnormalities is observed.
Do not use crane for pulling purpose.
Check crane in safe working order before work commencement
Stop lifting when abnormalities is observed.
Do not use crane for pulling purpose.

work_steps.step: Column fixing

control_measures: At least one full body harness lanyard to be attached at any given time
Mobile anchorage can be constructed along working platform to give workers more flexibility of movement
Use powered working platform if site condition permits (hard paving)
Do store objects on rebar column

work_steps.step: Rebar fixing (floor slab, walls, beams etc)

control_measures: Extra precaution to be paid when using light-duty working platform at floor edges
Deploy look-out person when using light-duty working platform at floor edges

work_steps.step: Rebar fixing (floor slab, walls, beams etc) (continue)

control_measures: Wear high heel safety shoes to avoid ankle twist
Install lighting at access
Give workers short brakes to prevent lack of focus of workers
Implement 5S management system

hazards.hazard: Twist injury induced by incorrect manual handling
control_measures: For large diameter rebar (Y32-Y50) that requires  multi-person manual handling, one person should be responsible for synchronizing movement of workers
Conduct pre-work exercise
Promotion of Safe working cycle

work_steps.step:
Delivery of concrete into site
by truck mixer

hazards.hazard:
Crash by truck mixer when
moving or reversing
control_measures: Clear and separate access should be provided for vehicle and pedestrians
Truck mixer should be equipped with cctv or
reversing alarm
Provision of signalman

hazards.hazard:
Hand injury by the conveyer
duct of truck mixer
control_measures: Fully extend the out-rigger onto the sound
ground
Warning notice should be displayed for beware of conveyer duct
Properly operate the conveyor duct when
pouring concrete

work_steps.step: Lifting of concrete hopper by Tower Crane

control_measures: Use of proper concrete hopper to deliver
concrete to working area
Proper rigging method with tag line
Concrete hopper should be tested and examined by R.P.E
Fenced off the lifting area
Assign banksman on spot monitoring the lifting operation
Do not overloading
Use proper lifting gear with adequate capacity
and valid certificate

hazards.hazard: Failure of lifting appliance and  lifting gear
control_measures: Check before use to ensure both LA & LG were examined and tested by RPE and the certificates are valid;
Check the lifting gears before use and ensure that they are in good condition & safe for use;
Do not exceed the SWL of lifting gear;
Banksman must be arranged on site.

work_steps.step: Concreting of wall and working floor

control_measures: Provision of proper working platform with
guardrail
Working platform should be inspected by competent person
Wear safety harness attached on the anchorage
point or independent life line
Proper access should be provided
Adequate width gangway (400mm) and barrier must be laid / erected to allow workers working on it
Work sequence and path should be clearly defined
Provision of concrete hopper with valid certificate
Working platform or floor edge should be installed with toe board
Proper rigging method
Proper lifting gear with adequate capacity should be provided.
A bucket for storing of accessories e.g bolt and
nuts should be provided
The workplace should be tidied up properly
Fence off the material storage area
Workers should put on non-slip safety shoes
Stop work during rainy/adverse weather condition.
Ensure the walls of steel-bars should be fixed on by timbers.
Ensure the walls of steel-bars checked by project engineer.
Re-bars should be protected.

work_steps.step: Use concrete vibrator to compact vest concrete

control_measures: Equip with fire fighting equipment nearby or at work place
Proper use of concrete vibrator especially for
lubricating
Proper store of flammable substance and away from working area
No smoking is allowed
Review the working program
Job rotation to the workers if necessary

hazards.hazard:
Noise by using of concrete
vibrator
control_measures: Wear proper PPE e.g ear plug/muff
Using of concrete vibrator with lower noise
Level
Conduct the Noise assessment
Add the Noise protection zone
Breaking area shall be fenced properly.
Workers working at the area shall wear eye goggles.
Prepare and establish specific contingency plan before concreting work.
Ensure the emergency procedure for typhoon (refer to safety plan) is followed.
Suspend outdoor works and workers stay in safe place.
No heavy materials stored at the edge of slope.

work_steps.step: Material handling

control_measures: To arrange enough workers to handle the materials.
To conduct the risk assessment of manual handling.
Use plant or equipment to assist to handle the materials.

work_steps.step: Work under hot weather

control_measures: Safety officer should inform workers and sub-contractor supervisors to take precautions
Workers not encouraged to consume drinks with caffeine
